intervals.label: assembly completed and commissioning
intervals.note: Start = completion of the basic assembly of the Demonstrator at LSM (November 2018); the sources do not date the start of commissioning itself, nor the earlier construction. The 2018-2020 report says 'The calorimeter is fully commissioned and the tracker commissioning is under progress'; a December 2024 paper still speaks of 'the final stages of installation and commissioning'.
intervals.quote: The most important result is the completion of the basic assembly of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator in November 2018

intervals.label: data taking
intervals.note: First ββ event recorded 10 April 2025; the June 2025 status talk reports 'Now in full data taking mode'. No later source was found, so whether data taking continues on 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.

placements.locator: report, Figure 1 caption (typo 'Demosntrator' in the source)
placements.quote: Demosntrator (first module), mounted under the clean tent in the main hall of the LSM laboratory (Modane, France)

summary.plain: One drum-shaped module: a wall of selenium foils, a gas tracker on both sides, and blocks of plastic scintillator outside, all inside layers of radon, neutron and gamma shielding.
summary.technical: Source frame with 34 82Se foils (96-99 % enriched, 250 um), 2034 Geiger cells (14970 wires) in a He/ethanol/Ar mixture, 712 optical modules (440 8-inch and 272 5-inch PMTs on polystyrene scintillator), magnetic coil ~25 G, 18 cm iron and 24 cm polyethylene shielding, anti-radon tent.

technology.quote: with the unique combination of a tracking detector and a segmented calorimeter
technology.value: 82Se source foils between a wire (Geiger-cell) tracker and a calorimeter of plastic-scintillator blocks read out by PMTs
